decision: Agent Brain is the canonical shared task-state service; legacy task folders are decomposed by outcome, not copied as repositories.

capabilities.contract: authorized task create, read, filtered list, and allowlisted update
single-writer API with BEGIN IMMEDIATE claim; one step cannot be claimed twice
immutable versions per task and artifact type
dry-run-first, profile-detected, field-allowlisted import; memory and timeline are explicit opt-ins
typed timeline events replace a second execution-log table
Runtime owns session execution; Brain receives shared lifecycle facts only
Project OS owns project planning structure; Brain tasks retain a project locator
Skills Hub owns capability discovery; Brain may store governed unit outcomes
Runtime enforces execution authority; Brain stores shared control decisions, not credentials
Reusable multi-step operating procedures version with playbooks
Timing and execution authority are outside a shared-state database

capabilities.capability: custom fields and generic task relationships
capabilities.contract: No current consumer evidence justifies schema promotion
No public adapter receives arbitrary SQL

capabilities.capability: machine-local database paths and committed runtime state
capabilities.contract: Configuration is explicit; databases and state remain outside source

legacy_units.reason: It mixes task state, project planning, runtime sessions, automation, tools, telemetry, and machine state; task portability now passes fixtures but a real local database must be reviewed before source retirement.
Its useful task/step/artifact behavior now has a tested service contract; direct SQLite and raw SELECT do not survive.
It is a broken wrapper over task-manager, not an independently releasable capability.

receipts.proves: empty-database migrations, API auth, task lifecycle, concurrent single-claim behavior, artifact versioning, outbox replay, durable merge, dry-run/apply/idempotent legacy imports, privacy opt-ins, install, and state-preserving uninstall
task steps and artifacts are additive; prior immutable migrations remain unchanged
every legacy capability has a named home, retirement decision, or explicit unverified state
reviewed Task Manager and OS Database layouts can move allowlisted durable state without importing private paths or mixed-system tables
